content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you're well. I've had a chance to review the agreement and would like to suggest a few adjustments before we sign. Here are my proposed modifications to the relevant clauses:

- The relevant clause requires absorbing any reasonable scope changes as long as they fall within the existing project budget. I propose revising it to state that changes to the scope of Services shall be documented in a written change order specifying the additional work, associated fees, and timeline, and shall be effective only upon written acceptance by both parties.

- The relevant clause commits to 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables. I propose reducing this to up to 3 rounds per Deliverable included in the fees, with any additional revision requests handled through a written change order specifying associated fees and timeline.

- The relevant clause on payment terms sets invoices at Net 60. I propose shortening the payment period to Net 30 from the date of invoice, while keeping the same interest provision for late payment as currently written.

- The relevant clause on the revision allowance states 15 rounds. I propose changing this to 3 rounds.

- The relevant clause on the payment period states Net 60. I propose changing this to Net 30.

Please let me know your thoughts on any of these points. I'm happy to talk through them or make further adjustments to reach a mutual understanding.

Warm regards,
